**Location:** Clifton, NJ (with flexibility for one remote day per week once fully onboarded)

**Compensation:** $130k - $150k base sary + bonus

Law Firm Experience Not Required!

Rosenblum Law is seeking a **senior-level Marketing Director** to own, lead, and scale our entire marketing operation. This is a hands-on leadership role with real budget authority, team oversight, and executive visibility.

You will report directly to the COO and be responsible for **strategy, execution, and performance** across all marketing channels for a fast-growing, multi-practice law firm.

**Law firm experience is NOT required.** What _is_ required is proven experience building and managing marketing systems that drive growth—especially across **digital, content, email, and social channels**.

## **About Rosenblum Law**

Rosenblum Law is a growth-focused, multi-practice law firm with a strong presence in estate planning, traffic tickets, and medical malpractice. We invest heavily in marketing, systems, and talent—and we are building a best-in-class in-house marketing operation.

## **Role Overview**

The Marketing Director will **own all marketing channels and initiatives**, oversee internal staff and external agencies, and manage a **$700,000+ annual marketing budget**. This role blends strategic leadership with strong editorial judgment and operational discipline.

This is an **in-office role in Clifton, NJ**, with flexibility for **one remote day per week** once fully onboarded.

## **Key Responsibilities**

### **Marketing Strategy & Leadership**

- Own and execute the firm’s overall marketing strategy across all practice areas
- Translate firm goals into clear marketing priorities, campaigns, and KPIs
- Partner closely with the COO and firm leadership on growth initiatives


### **Channel Oversight (End-to-End Ownership)**

- Email marketing (campaigns, automations, newsletters)
- Social media (organic + paid strategy and growth)
- Content marketing (written + video)
- Paid search (overseeing and managing an external agency)
- Conversion rate optimization (landing pages, funnels, forms)
- Design & creative direction
- Traditional advertising, including direct mail
- Estate planning events & workshops, working closely with the EP team

### **Marketing Technology, Automation & AI**

- Own and improve the firm’s **marketing automation stack**
- Design and optimize email, SMS, CRM, and lead-nurture workflows
- Identify opportunities to reduce manual work through automation
- Ensure clean data flow between marketing platforms, CRM, and intake systems
- Evaluate, select, and manage marketing and AI vendors/tools

### **Team & Vendor Management**

- Manage and develop the existing Marketing Support team member
- Hire and oversee a Social Media Manager
- Oversee and hold accountable external agencies and vendors
- Ensure timelines, quality, and performance standards are met


### **Editorial & Brand Oversight**

- Serve as the final quality gatekeeper for all outward-facing marketing
- Ensure consistency, clarity, and professionalism across all communications
- Maintain strong brand voice across email, content, ads, and social


### **Budget & Performance Management**

- Own and manage a $700,000+ annual marketing budget
- Track ROI, channel performance, and campaign effectiveness
- Make data-driven decisions on spend allocation and optimization

## **Required Experience & Qualifications**

- **Law firm experience is NOT required.**
- 5–10 years of marketing leadership experience with hands-on ownership of digital channels
- Proven experience managing paid and organic social growth
- Strong background in email marketing, content strategy, and editorial review
- Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or similar major strongly preferred
- Exceptional attention to detail and editorial judgment
- Experience managing agencies and vendors
- Comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels
- Confident leader with the ability to manage, hire, and develop team members

## **Benefits & Compensation**

- **Performance-based bonus up to 10% of total compensation**
- **Health insurance**
- **401(k) plan**
- Paid time off and firm holidays
- Opportunity to work directly with executive leadership and shape firm-wide growth strategy
